scene: Through the brass eyepiece, three busy transit hubs gleam below across town.
picture: Close view looking through the circular brass telescope reticle. Crosshairs divide a vibrant city panorama below. On the far left, a smoking paddle steamer bobs beside a wooden pier. In the centre sits a yellow skate-park shuttle van with open doors. On the far right, a tall red double-decker bus idles at a kerb.
